big_case.notes: A Section 1983 pretrial-detainee conditions case from the Fifth Circuit dismissed at the pleading stage: five days on suicide watch in a bare cell after an admittedly false suicide report. Published opinion with a dissent and a call for response, but no clean circuit split, fact-bound questions, Texas trial-bar counsel, no cert-stage amicus, and the Court denied with no noted dissent. Real stakes for the jail population, little doctrinal or public reach.
